info.title: Air Alert Monitor API
info.description:
Tracks Ukrainian air raid alert history and stats, built on top of the Ubilling aerial alerts feed.

**Data Latency:** Updates are polled every 5 seconds and require 2 confirmations (~10s total latency).

**Rate Limiting:** Public access is limited to 60 requests per minute per IP.

get.summary: Get current alert status for regions
get.description: Returns the current alert status for all regions, optionally filtered by id, name, or active state. If neither `ids` nor `names` are provided, all regions are returned.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Filter by region id. Cannot be combined with `names`.

parameters.name: names
parameters.description: Filter by region name. Cannot be combined with `ids`.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: If set, only return regions whose alert-active state matches this value

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: IANA timezone used to format the `since` timestamp, e.g. `Europe/Kyiv`

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language for the region name: `ua` or `en`

400.description: Both `ids` and `names` provided, or `tz` is not a valid IANA timezone

parameters.name: period

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of an explicit date range (ISO-8601 offset date-time)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of an explicit date range (ISO-8601 offset date-time). Defaults to now.

400.description: `tz` is invalid, `period` is unrecognized, or `from` is after `to`

webhookSignature.name: X-Signature

post.description:
Sent to your subscribed URL whenever a tracked region's alert starts or ends.

The request is signed: verify the `X-Signature` header (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body, using the `secret` returned at registration) before trusting the payload.

Respond with any 2xx status within a reasonable timeout. Non-2xx responses count toward the subscription's consecutive failure count and may auto-disable it.api.webhook.callback.res.200=Notification acknowledged. Also accepts any other 2xx status.

200.description: Notification acknowledged. Also accepts any other 2xx status.

5XX.description: Treated as a delivery failure. Counts toward the subscription's consecutive failure count; the subscription is auto-disabled after repeated failures.

default.description: Any non-2xx response (including timeouts) is treated as a delivery failure.
